area: Realm world: goal line / daily quests
title: Quest zone names and Lv 1 goal line (G-06)
steps: Fresh profile, ?mode=world&seed=4242, kill 4 shore creatures via hook, read the Next goal line
Set hero level 8 and read the line again
expected: Zone names are canon; a Lv 1 hero keeps a reachable goal.
actual: Lv 1 after 4 kills: 'Reach Lv 5 for Midlands (Lv 1)' (no longer jumps to the quest). Lv 8: 'Defeat 22 creatures in the Highlands (0/22)'. mm-quests.js now uses the canon names. Quest board panel text not read in detail.

title: Altar wakes by zone (G-07)
steps: seed 4242, hero on a lower-zone tile 4-8 tiles from a zone 1 / 2 altar, bossTick x20 (10 s)
Hero inside the altar zone, 8.2 tiles away, real-time play
expected: Lower-zone hero never wakes the altar; in-zone hero does.
actual: 3 altars (Sand Titan z1 from z0, Hydra z2 from z1, Crystal Titan z2 from z1): none woke for the lower-zone hero. In-zone hero at 8.2 tiles: 'Sand Titan awakens!' after 1 s. Lv 8 hero died in 15 s.

title: Provoked off-screen whirler (G-08)
steps: Spawn a Whirler 400 px above the view, hit it once, wait 2 s real time
expected: It fires or closes in within 2 s.
actual: Unprovoked: _canFire false. After one hit: provT 4, fired 21 bullets in 2 s and walked 40 px closer.

title: 0-kill death no longer pays a cache
steps: Lv 8 hero dies after 1 kill / 15 s alive
expected: No free cache for a trivial run.
actual: Death card: 'no cache this time (3 kills or a minute alive earns one)'. The 4-death suicide loop itself was not re-run.

title: Goal line cut off
steps: 390x844 touch, fresh hero, read the goal line
actual: Line now wraps to two lines and the zone target is visible. Gear toast overlap and 'Blizzard' label clip not retested (needs a Frostcaller plus a drop).

title: Boss bar over boss / zone banner mid fight
steps: Wake Sand Titan, die to it
expected: Boss bar hides nothing and is gone after death.
actual: Bar is still drawn on the 'You fell' card after death. The overlap with a boss at the top of the screen was not re-seen in this run.

title: Hero on solid tile
actual: Outside the retest list; not reproducible in round 1.

title: After teleport to zone-3 tile (120,114) the zone line read 'Highlands · Deadly' after 4 s
steps: Teleport via the test hook to a zone-3 tile, hold fire + D for 4 s, read the zone line
expected: Zone line matches the hero tile zone (Godlands).
actual: Line read Highlands (centre distance 22). Could be teleport/HUD lag or a radius mismatch with World.zone[]; unconfirmed.
